m: A *cloaked beggar* lunges out onto the *road* in the hot *sun*; a guard grabs his arm to **restrain** him.
*Crumbs* of glowing ash fly up from the *campfire* and twinkle in the dark: **luminous** sparks.
A *dog* pushes its *nose* and *mouth* into the grass: **sniff**, sniff.
Behind the *curtains*, a *mouth* yells 'pa!' like the starter's gun: **bang**!
Stir the pot with a *cane* over low *embers* for hours and hours: **simmer**.
Lifting the *towel* with a *cane*, you steal a quick look with one *eye*: a **glance**.
Every *bone* of a *person*, wired together in the museum: a **skeleton**.
A *big man* with *grey hair* dyes it gold so it shines like the *sun*: so **extravagant**.
A *helping hand* tries to balance a *mountain* on a *mountain*, and it all topples: **clumsy**.
A *tree* trunk is hoisted onto a *bent cross* of beams, *crumbs* of plaster falling: one more **building** goes up.
Spread *fur* on the floor between two *campfires* to sit on: a warm **rug**.
A *tree* curves like an *archway* over the *covered mouth* of a well, its big purple flowers dropping: the **paulownia** tree.
Grind a *stone* down until it is just a *pinch* of tiny grains: **sand**.
He charges headlong through the tall wild *grass* without looking where he's going: **reckless**.
Lift the *cloth cover* off the *gift* and *water drops* rush out everywhere: they **pour out**.
Rake the *soil* flat under the *drying rack* with a pair of *horns*: a wide, level **plain**.
Carve a piece of *tree* into fine teeth to tame the *tumbling baby*'s wild hair: a **comb**.
A *tree* covered from top to bottom in needle-like *bristles*: a **fir**.
In the *sun*, two old friends wind talk round like thread on a *spool*, *mouth* to mouth: they **meet**.
A baby *sparrow* hides under a short new *grain stalk*: both still **young**.
The *tumbling baby* rolls off a *cloth roll* into the green *grass* of the garden: carrots, cabbages, **vegetables**.
The *frog* flicks its tongue at a buzzing *bug*: a **fly**.
A *helping hand* brings the pestle down like a falling *mountain*: **pound** the garlic.
A *spoon* rests on a *page* of land records, measuring wide fields: one big **unit of area**.
A strand of *hemp* split again and again into a *tiny thread*: so **tiny** you can hardly see it.
Hopping on a *crutch*, you knock a *dish* of soup into the host's lap: so **awkward**.
From a *cabinet* by the *altar*, a guard throws a little blade that flashes like *gold coins*: a **dart**.
A *grass blade* grows down through your *roof*, and your *small speech bubble* says: what?! **Astonished**.
A *person* on a *crutch* slips over at the party, and the room goes silent: **embarrassing**.
A yellow *stone* that smells so bad the *tumbling baby* rolls away from it: **sulfur**.
A *claw* stuffs food in, and the *mouth* goes round and round: **chew**.
Freezing, *icicles* on your *yawn*, you stare at the *sheep* snug in its wool: you **envy** it.
A *person* clinging to a *spoon* slips below the *water drops*: he **sinks**.
A *door* opening onto the *water drops* of the river mouth: the great port, **Shanghai**.
The *sun* is shining and the school *shed* stands empty: everyone has decided to **skip class**.
Two neat *trees* with trimmed *bristles* of leaves flank the gate: a **well-bred** family lives here.
A tiny green *fang* pokes up through the *grass*: a **sprout**.
Not quite a *prowling dog*, it slips into the *village* at night after chickens: a **wild cat**.
Throw a *cloth cover* over the *sun*, put a *lid* on top, draw the *curtains*: deep **dark**.
A *left hand* digs black *stone* from the *mountain* to feed the *campfire*: coal, pure **carbon**.
A *skeleton* holding a *standing knife* stretches its *mouth* wide: a bony **grin**.
Your *standing heart* stays awake under the *blanket* until the *sun* comes up, listening for the thief: **wary**.
Two *suns* blaze down, and even *grey hair* drips with sweat: summer **heat**.
Two *mouths* on *trudging feet* waddle round the farmyard: the hens **cackle**.
By the *dusk moon*, pull up the *grass* tops and lift a *fishing net* full of white roots: **radishes**.
*Water drops* roar down into the *pit*, slicing like *scissors*: a **torrential** rush.
Fish left out from *moon* till *sun* beside the *seedling* bed: what a **fishy** smell.
A *person* hidden in the *cave* peers between *two planks*, a silent *watcher*: he **peeps**.
A *standing person*, a *big man* just missed by a *lightning bolt*, shouts in country dialect: '**I** didn't do it!'
*Water drops* tumble from the waterfall into a dark, still **deep pool**.
A *big man* hammers a *nail* into the *mountain* rock, his *mouth* puffing at every step: the land is **mountainous**.
A *deer* with scales like grains of *rice* prances on *dancing feet*: the magical **qilin**.
A *helping hand* gathers fallen sticks around the *tent*: **pick up** the firewood.
A *helping hand* and an *assistant* haul the swimmer out of the waves: **rescue**!
A stag with *antlers* gives one last *yawn* under the *cliff*, then drops among the *sprouts*: it **faints**.
Stand with *spread feet* in the stream; the *water drops* are so still you can see each *bean* on the bottom: **clear**.
A *woman* looks sadly at her *grass* and *grain stalk*, drooping brown in the drought: they **wither**.
A warrior plants his *halberd* in the *soil* and his *mouth* cries out: 'Alas!' An old-fashioned **exclamation**.
Under the bridge's *archway*, *water drops* spin round a gaping *mouth* that tugs at a *person*'s boat: a **whirlpool**.
*Water drops* surge over the bank like a grabbing *claw*, filling every *mortar* in the village: a **torrent**.
A *lying man* stretches out on *two planks* in the *sun*: pure **leisure**.
A stag with *antlers* wades against the *water drops*, past every *sprout*, under the *moon*: it will **go upstream** to the source.
A *fish* shimmers with flakes like grains of *rice* as it twists on *dancing feet*: its **scales**.
Leave a *good meal* of grapes in the *wine jug* for months: you **brew** wine.
Inside a *fence*, a *big man* lies back on thick, soft *grass*: a natural **mattress**.
Your *standing heart* jumps and two *mouths* gasp as the *leaky pot* suddenly bursts: **startled**.
Squint one *eye* at the *campfire* to see if the *grain stalk* is roasted: you **look at** it.
The *grass* turns grey as the sun sinks behind it: **evening**.
At the *crossroads*, clerks wind red tape on a *spool* while a *mouth* calls the next case: the **government office**.
A *small speech bubble* hangs on a *halberd* stuck in the *grass*: 'Keep out!' A stern **commandment**.
*Father*'s small *axe*, just right for splitting kindling: a **hatchet**.
Behind the *curtains*, an ancient poet ends every line with a *puff of breath*: a sighing, **poetic ah**.
A *big man* under the *archway* polishes a *bent knife* by the *campfire* until it gleams: **shining**.
A *tree* whose fronds make a *roof* over the beach *altar*: a **palm**.
A *standing person* lays a *left hand* on your head and her *mouth* murmurs: may heaven **bless** you.
Hide the *axe* and offer the horse a *candy*: its *mouth* opens in a happy **neigh**.
In old novels, a *woman* waits under a willow *branch* by the pleasure house, selling her company: a **prostitute**.
*Mouths* shout from every *roof* all the way to the *horizon*: what a **clamor**.
*Grass* and a *roof* in a *valley* where beans are mashed into a sweet filling: lotus seed **paste**.
Slice one strip out of the *bamboo book* with a *standing knife*: **delete** that line.
A *woman* under a pink-blossomed *tree* picks small red fruit: **cherries**.
A *standing person* hovers beside the *boss* all day long: he **waits on** him.
A bee with tiny *feathers* for wings hovers by the *curtains*; you raise an *elbow* and its *mouth* goes **buzz**.
A *woman* holds a *halberd* in one *hand* and still looks lovely: **beautiful**.
High up the *tree*, where *sprinkles* of *moon*light touch the very end: the **branch tip**.
Pile *soil* and *shells* right across the river: a **dam**.
A *bug* that spins a thread as long as the *sky*: a **silkworm**.
Use a *cane* to rake manure over every *square* of the *seedbed*: **spread** it evenly.
*Water drops* swell over the *gate* and climb up the *tree*: **big waves**.
A *tree* whose golden fruit drops straight into your open *mouth*: an **apricot**.
A *woman* calms a snarling *claw* by wrapping it in soft *silk thread*: she **pacifies** the beast.
Metal melts like *icicles* in the furnace; *elbow* deep in heat, *mouth* dripping sweat, you **smelt** the ore.
The *twins* hide from the storm inside the *shed*: it **protects** them.
Climb onto a *tall stool* so a *helping hand* can reach your back and **scratch** the itch.
A *woman* drops her bag of *rice* and throws a *helping hand* round her friend: a big **hug**.
A person turns, a dog darts across the path and is gone in a flash: **sudden**.
Two *right hands* cup round an *ear*: **whisper** a secret.
Under the *roof* by the *dusk moon*, a *woman* turns down a *bowing man* softly and kindly: **tactful**.
Four crows' *mouths* squawk from one *tree* all at once: what a **noise**.
*Grain stalks* to feed the family under the *roof* and the *pig* in its sty: the farm's **crops**.
An *old man* sitting in the *sun* watches a *fish* wave its little paddle: a **fin**.
*Trudging feet* wade through the pond *grass* to pick horned black nuts: **water caltrops**.
*Twin blades* of flame rise from an oil *dish*: a lamp burning in a **small cup**.
A *left hand* pulls *grass* over the *open crate* and covers the child's *mouth*: they **hide**.
The old *branch* bends in the wind, and a little *mouth* in the wood squeaks: **creak**.
The quiet room under the *roof* where you lie down at night: the **bedroom**.
A *helping hand* scoops up everything on the table while the *watcher* stares: he **seizes** it all.
On the *workbench*, a *left hand* cracks a *bone* found on the *road* by *moon*light: the soft **marrow** inside.
A hand like a *long comb* closes round a *grain stalk*: **grasp** it.
A mother bird drops seeds from the *seedbed* into the chick's open *mouth*: she **feeds** it.
A *big man* stretched thin, with feathers like a *slanted cap* on top: an *arrow* ready to fly, an **arrow**.
A *helping hand* claps once and a *white dove* bursts out of the magician's *mouth*: **pop**!
A *towel* painted with a shouting *mouth* waves between the *curtains*: the team's **flag**.
A man with a *knife* and a loud *mouth* lives up on the *hillside*; his gate is marked with the **surname Shao**.
Two *mouths* by the *tree* *yawn* wide, then hack and splutter: a bad **cough**.
A *person* tucks *two planks* and a pair of *horns* under one arm, a *helping hand* holding firm: he **clasps** them tight.
A *clay jar* so huge it needs its own *workbench* to stand on: a **vat**.
A *helping hand* rolls the dough with a *spear* shaft on a board cut from a *tree*: **knead** it.
Under the *moon*, fat drips off a *tethered arrow* of kebab meat onto *two planks* and a *shell*: everything is **greasy**.
Lead the wild *horse* back and forth across the *river* until it obeys you: you **tame** it.
A *watcher* on the dock winds thick *silk thread* round and round a post: a ship's **cable**.
The *sun* sits straight above the *roof*, and every *mouth* wants lunch: **midday**.
On the *sickbed*, his *right hand* cannot even lift to shoo a *sparrow*: **paralyzed**.
Put your *shells* away in the *storeroom*: **store** them for later.
A *watcher* scratches through the fallen leaves with a *claw*: he **seeks** what was lost.
The *moon* is wrapped in a *blanket* of mist above the *grass*: the light is **dim**.
A *standing person* and a *lying man* eat *chili* far from town, no other *mouth* for miles: **remote**.
Over the *hillside* runs the Grand Canal, dug by one short-lived royal house: the **Sui dynasty**.
*Grass* reaches for the *sun* and crawls over the garden wall: a **creeper**.
A hungry *mouth* gnaws at *two planks*: **bite**.
Press *candy* into a cake *mountain*; the cake *yawns* open and holds each piece: you **inlay** them.
A *tiger* with a holy *tattoo* bows its head before the temple: **reverent**.
Ox *horns* poke up along the edge of the *rice field*: the ox rests at the lake's **side**.
The *king* is pestered all day with tiny matters, like who ate whose cake: **trifling**.
A *stone* disc, round as the *globe*, set on a table cut from a *tree*: a **plate**.
*Water drops* of unripe persimmon juice dry out your whole tongue: **astringent**.
A *dragon* coils round the *moon* in clouds: the light is **hazy**.
A driver with *grey hair* crosses the *hillside* in the *sun*, and his horn's *mouth* goes **toot**.
A *kicking foot* springs over a *mountain*, past one *moon* and then another *moon*: **hop**!
A *cloth cover* of earth heaped over a *shackled pig* from ancient times: a **burial mound**.
*Water drops* so clear you can read a diver's *tattoo* and see his *standing knife*: **clear**.
A *robe* handed under the *archway*, through the *curtains*, *mouth* to *mouth*: passed down to the **descendants**.
Pin a sprig from two *trees* to your *shirt* front before the *altar*: on your **lapel**.
A *mouth* that chops out words as fast as a *knife*: **garrulous**.
A *person* leans close and passes you a *small speech bubble* with the secret: the **knack**.
A *crowbar* prises the *sun* up over the hill: the **rising sun**.
A tiny sea *bug* scuttles *downstairs* to the bottom of the tank: a **shrimp**.
A *bamboo* notebook smudged with *water drops*, where your *thumb* ticks off each *seedbed*: the **register**.
Raise the glass to your *mouth* and clink the glasses in a *cross*: **beer**!
A *person* follows *paw prints* and grabs the fox with a *helping hand*: **capture**.
